args:
DATA="${PGS_PLUGIN_DATA:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA:-${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/pgs-plugin}}"; VERSION="0.4.1"; BINARY="$DATA/bin/pgs-mcp"; VERSION_FILE="$DATA/VERSION"; INSTALLED_VERSION="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "$VERSION_FILE" 2>/dev/null || true)"; if [ ! -x "$BINARY" ] || [ "$INSTALLED_VERSION" != "$VERSION" ]; then OS="$(uname -s)"; ARCH="$(uname -m)"; case "$OS:$ARCH" in Darwin:*) BINARY_NAME="pgs-mcp-universal-apple-darwin" ;; Linux:x86_64) BINARY_NAME="pgs-mcp-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl" ;; Linux:aarch64) BINARY_NAME="pgs-mcp-aarch64-unknown-linux-musl" ;; MINGW*:x86_64|MSYS*:x86_64|CYGWIN*:x86_64) BINARY_NAME="pgs-mcp-x86_64-pc-windows-msvc.exe" ;; *) printf 'pgs-mcp: unsupported platform: %s %s
' "$OS" "$ARCH" >&2; exit 127 ;; esac; if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'pgs-mcp: curl is required to install pgs-mcp %s
' "$VERSION" >&2; exit 127; fi; mkdir -p "$DATA/bin" || exit 127; URL="https://github.com/UtsavBalar1231/pgs/releases/download/v$VERSION/$BINARY_NAME"; printf 'pgs-mcp: downloading %s
' "$URL" >&2; if ! curl -fsSL "$URL" -o "$BINARY"; then rm -f "$BINARY"; exit 127; fi; chmod +x "$BINARY" || exit 127; printf '%s
' "$VERSION" > "$VERSION_FILE" || exit 127; fi; exec "$BINARY" "$@"
